title.ja: 睡眠不足の遅番勤務者を早めの休憩提案で守る
title.en: Protect a sleep-deprived late-shift worker with an early rest proposal

brief.ja: 物流担当者は日中に十分眠れず、身体負荷の高い遅番勤務を終え、短い間を置いただけで運転を始める。 夜間に東京–大阪の高速道路で帰宅し、地図上の最初のサービスエリアが現実的な停車候補となる。 AICAは15分以内に休憩必要を1回提案し、眠気を正の根拠として説明した後、走行中に使える音声支援を提示する。
brief.en: A logistics worker slept poorly during the day, completed a physically demanding late shift, and starts driving after only a brief pause. They must drive home at night on the Tokyo–Osaka expressway, where the first mapped service area is the practical stopping option. AICA should issue one rest-required proposal within 15 minutes, explain drowsiness positively, and then offer driving-capable audio support.

Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 1–2 (physical fatigue/drowsiness rest proposal through arrival at a rest facility); post-rest behavior is out of scope.

rationale.en: Low physical signals separate repetitive-road attention support from exhaustion, while profile and schedule personalize only downstream content. Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 10–17 and 66–80 for monotony recovery and preference inputs; concert context is not a fatigue proxy.

name.ja: コンサートへ向かう休養十分なJ-rockファン
name.en: Rested J-rock fan driving to a concert

narrative.ja: コンサートへ向かう休養十分なJ-rockファン。十分休んだJ-rockファンには間もなくコンサート予定があり、対応済み音楽の強い回復履歴がある。
narrative.en: Rested J-rock fan driving to a concert. A well-rested J-rock fan has a concert scheduled soon and a strong supported-music recovery history.

goals.ja: 必要な移動を、運転の安全を損なわずに終える。
goals.en: Complete this necessary journey without compromising driving safety.

preferences.ja: 操作をハンズフリーに保ち、間近のコンサートに合う活発なJ-rockを好む。
preferences.en: Favor energetic J-rock fitting the upcoming concert while keeping interaction hands-free.

constraints.ja: 走行中は注意を維持し、画面操作はできない。
constraints.en: The driver must remain attentive and cannot operate a screen while moving.

assumptions.ja: 漫然回復と嗜好入力はCDC-SUスライド10–17および66–80に基づき、コンサート文脈を疲労代理にはしない。
assumptions.en: Grounded in CDC-SU Slides 10–17 and 66–80 for monotony recovery and preference inputs; concert context is not a fatigue proxy.

assumptions.ja: 解決済みのprofile-semantic-jrock-fan履歴は出発前に固定し、リプレイ中は変更しません。
assumptions.en: The resolved profile-semantic-jrock-fan history is fixed before the trip and is not changed during replay.

narrative.ja: コンサート会場へ長く反復的な昼間高速道路を走る。 早い休憩地点を通過し、身体的には休養したまま長時間の高速反復が蓄積する。
narrative.en: They drive a long repetitive daytime expressway to the concert venue. The early rest point passes and prolonged highway repetition accumulates while the driver remains physically rested.
